newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SBAB might convert bonds to euro from crown-report.
newsitem.headline: SBAB might convert bonds to euro from crown-report.

text.p: The Swedish National Housing Finance Corp., SBAB, is looking into possibilities to convert part of its bond portfolio to euro from crowns, Swedish business weekly Veckans Affarer reported on Monday.
"We have been in discussions with a number of large investors about converting outstanding benchmark loans to euro," Goran Lauren, head of finance at SBAB, told the weekly.
In total, SBAB has loans worth 70 billion crowns.
Behind the plan are worries that the crown bonds will not be liquid enough after the euro has been introduced in 1999, Veckans Affarer said.
